hero.heading: Welcome to Celestial Mechanics
hero.lead: We design and hand-build custom, immersive orreries: working models of the solar system you can stand under, walk around, and set in motion.

experience.heading: A working sky, at the scale of a room
experience.body: An orrery is a three-hundred-year-old idea: the planets, carried around the Sun by a mechanism. Each planet at its own pace. We build them large enough to inhabit. The planets really move, the light is real, and the effect on the people who stand beneath it is something we never tire of watching. As humanity turns its attention back to the stars, there has never been a better moment to bring a solar system into your home or place of business.
experience.caption: Illustrative: Eight worlds, each turning at its own pace, in your home, or on your premises.

audiences.heading: One orrery. Three kinds of home.

residence.title: Residential
residence.text: A conversational centrepiece for the great room, the library or the garden. The object every guest remembers.

institution.title: Institutional
institution.text: For museums, planetariums, universities and public spaces: an immersive lesson that sparks a lifetime of curiosity.

business.title: Commercial
business.text: For hotels, galleries, gardens and headquarters: interactive art that reflects what you stand for.

bespoke.heading: Crafted, not manufactured
bespoke.body: We don't keep a catalogue. Every Celestial Mechanics orrery begins with your space and your story, and is drawn, machined and assembled for your requirements. These are the choices we shape together:

items.title: The configuration
items.text: Choose from just the Earth, Moon and Sun (a Tellurion); the four inner planets; or a Grand Orrery of all eight planets.

items.title: The planets
items.text: Small, medium, or large. In lightweight, drop-resistant PE material or exquisite hand-blown glass.

items.title: The mechanism
items.text: An individual motor and belt for each world, or a fixed single drive with mechanical gearing.

items.title: The Sun
items.text: A luminous sphere, or a living, breathing propane-fed fireball.

process.heading: How an orrery comes to be

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: We learn about you (or your organization), your space, and the people who will gather there.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We return with drawings and a proposal tailored to you: scale, materials, mechanism and finish.

steps.title: Crafting
steps.text: Your orrery is hand-built in our studio in British Columbia, every arm, gear and planet receives our full attention.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We ship it to you, install it, set it in motion, and show you how to operate your own piece of the cosmos.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: We work with you to establish an after sales support program depending on the traffic and frequency of use.

grandOrrery.heading: The Grand Orrery
grandOrrery.body: Eight planets carried around the Sun beneath a dome of light: the Grand Orrery is the piece that started the studio. It has captivated crowds in California and British Columbia, and continues to travel to events in North America & Europe.
grandOrrery.imageAlt: Guests lying beneath the dome of The Grand Orrery, gazing up at the glowing planets

closing.heading: Every orrery begins with a conversation.
closing.text: Tell us about your space. We'll take it from there.
